title: In This World Every Promise Ties A Red Thread
description: Ren has worn the same red thread for ten years, so everyone calls him a liar. Who would you still owe a promise to? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Ren: 16-year-old Japanese high-school boy, short messy black hair, sleepy dark eyes, no hat, navy blazer school uniform, white shirt, loose red tie, gray trousers, one faded red thread tied around his left little finger
characters.Aoi: 16-year-old Japanese high-school girl, shoulder-length chestnut-brown hair with a small yellow hairclip, no hat, navy sailor uniform with a red scarf, navy pleated skirt, white socks, brown loafers

scenes.say: In this world, every promise ties a red thread around your finger, and it only falls off once you keep it. Ren has worn the same thread for ten years.
scenes.video: [0-4s] A quiet train platform in a small Japanese town in the morning, close-up of two students' hands, thin red threads around their fingers. [4-7s] One thread on a girl's finger loosens and slips away as she smiles at a friend. [7-10s] Close-up of Ren standing alone at the end of the platform, a single faded red thread on his left little finger.

scenes.say: So at school, everyone calls him the liar. Nobody sits near him, until a transfer student named Aoi takes the empty desk beside him and stares at the faded thread.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Inside a sunlit high-school classroom, two girls whisper and glance at Ren sitting alone by the window. [4-7s] Aoi walks down the aisle of the classroom and sits at the empty desk next to Ren. [7-10s] Close-up of Aoi's eyes dropping to the faded red thread on Ren's little finger.

scenes.say: She asks who he promised. He won't say. But at lunch he keeps turning something over in his pocket, and once, she hears it click like glass.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the school rooftop at lunch beside a chain-link fence, Aoi sits a little apart from Ren, holding a bento box, asking a question. [4-7s] Ren looks away at the sky, saying nothing. [7-10s] Close-up of Ren's hand in his blazer pocket, fingers turning something small and round.

scenes.say: So she tells him her oldest story. At six, she was stuck in a hospital, and a boy in the waiting room borrowed her blue marble. She left before he returned it.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the school rooftop, Aoi talks softly, looking at her hands. [4-7s] Faded warm flashback inside a small hospital waiting room with plastic chairs: six-year-old Aoi with the same chestnut hair and yellow hairclip hands a blue glass marble to a small black-haired boy. [7-10s] In the same hospital waiting room, a nurse leads little Aoi away by the hand while the boy holds up the marble too late.

scenes.say: Ren goes completely still. Then he opens his hand. In his palm is a small blue marble, scratched from ten years in a pocket. Aoi's hands start to shake.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the school rooftop, Ren freezes, staring at Aoi. [4-7s] Close-up of Ren's open palm: a small scratched blue glass marble catching the afternoon light, the faded red thread on his little finger. [7-10s] Close-up of Aoi's face, eyes wide and wet, hands trembling at her chest.

scenes.say: He drops it into her palm, and the red thread slips off his finger. A new one ties itself around hers. She just promised to sit beside him tomorrow.
scenes.video: [0-4s] On the school rooftop, close-up of Ren placing the blue marble into Aoi's palm. [4-7s] The faded red thread loosens and floats off Ren's finger in the breeze. [7-10s] Medium shot of Aoi smiling through tears as a fresh red thread wraps around her little finger, Ren smiling for the first time.
